atomicity.reason: One obligation: a control-logic module producing steering corrections. 'Smooth' and 'precise' are qualities of the single output, not separate requirements.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained and intelligible on its own; 'detected lane positions' is understandable without external context.

feasibility.reason: Steering-correction control logic is implementable with known technology and contradicts nothing else stated.

parent_fit.reason: NEED_001 requires providing corrective steering; this requirement substantively addresses that half via a steering-correction control-logic module.

unambiguity.reason: Has a single valid reading: derive steering corrections from detected lane positions.

verifiability.reason: Directionally testable against detected lane positions, but 'smooth' and 'precise' are unmeasured quality adjectives with no defined thresholds.
verifiability.suggestion: Quantify 'smooth' (e.g. max steering jerk/rate limit) and 'precise' (e.g. max lateral deviation from lane center).

summary: Substantively covers the steering-correction arm of NEED_001; a single control-logic obligation, but 'smooth and precise' are unquantified quality adjectives.
